availability_basis: Anonymous HTTPS HEAD/GET checks from this intake (2026-11-03) returned 200 for all five canonical apo PDB sources, the PINDER source archive and the MEGADOCK source archive; the PINDER source archive was downloaded and its SHA-256 b577532820ebbe5c16432b78c5e9c197690e863cb70a0a35a8ebcbe5277b76dd matches the brief. Apo payload hashes were not recomputed in intake; setup must verify them.

excluded_inputs.FroDock unverified mirror: Not used; this calibration runs MEGADOCK only.
